scenario: repairing a bulk RNA-seq differential-expression package for the public pasilla dataset
user_visible_goal: Recover a reproducible treatment-vs-control differential-expression package that separates technical factors from treatment signal and rebuilds the downstream panel summary.

skill_hypothesis.with_skill: The solver is more likely to recognize raw-count semantics, fit the configured multi-factor design, preserve contrast direction, and keep the panel summary aligned with the corrected DE results.
skill_hypothesis.without_skill: The solver is more likely to keep or recreate a simpler single-factor analysis, miss the baseline-vs-corrected panel audit, and fail to reconcile stable, rescued, and nuisance-sensitive panel genes into one consistent deliverable.

main_tests: All required outputs exist, are parseable, and respect the declared column contracts.
The final significant panel output matches the corrected multi-factor analysis derived from the shipped counts and metadata.
panel_diagnostics.tsv reconciles baseline and corrected models across the full shipped review panel.
report.json and normalized_counts.tsv are internally consistent with significant_genes.tsv and panel_diagnostics.tsv.
guardrails: Outputs must not reproduce the shipped broken panel summary behavior.
The corrected report must encode both a baseline single-factor formula and the final multi-factor formula.
No copied broken deliverables or static placeholder files may pass.

data_provenance.reference_source: Bioconductor pasilla experiment package (Brooks et al., Genome Research 2011) gene-level count matrix and sample annotation.
data_provenance.panel_source: Curated review panel derived from stable corrected hits, genes rescued only after nuisance adjustment, and nuisance-sensitive false positives from the pasilla counts.
